messages.author: c944e424fd78eae4
messages.subject: Hide rendered datatable
parts:
I am using the DT package currently for my rendered data table.

Is there anyway to hide a fully rendered data table? I still need it to render just not show on the ui. Or at the least, be able hide a number of the columns? I still need the table to be rendered because I am making a file based on this table after a set of inputs are made by the user. 

Thank you.

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Hide rendered datatable
parts:
You can hide a datatable with `shinyjs::hide()`.

You can also use the ColVis extension of DT https://rstudio.github.io/DT/extensions.html

Or you could use the `visible` option to make certain columns not show https://datatables.net/reference/option/columns.visible 

DT::datatable(mtcars,
                 options = list(
                 columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE,
                                          targets = 1:5))
                 )
   )

On Tuesday, 1 December 2015 04:19:29 UTC-8, Josh wrote:
I am using the DT package currently for my rendered data table.

Is there anyway to hide a fully rendered data table? I still need it to render just not show on the ui. Or at the least, be able hide a number of the columns? I still need the table to be rendered because I am making a file based on this table after a set of inputs are made by the user. 

Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: Hide rendered datatable
parts:
Querybuilder passes what data are left after filtering back to DT to render. I think this works similar to the way DT filters with the basic column filters. Then based on what rows are displayed, I use input$table_all_rows to get what rows are being displayed by DT after filtering. 

Meanwhile the DT is left hidden, for the most part (except for some basic information about how many items are in the table). 

Hope this helps.
